summary_en: This study tests sacituzumab govitecan-hziy (SG), given at an alternative dose and schedule, in people with advanced triple-negative breast cancer. SG is given into a vein (intravenously), and participants receive it until progression, death, unacceptable toxicity, or another stop criterion is met; the specific dose and how often it is given are not stated. The study measures safety and tolerability, objective response rate, and progression-free survival (Phase 1/2).
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa sacituzumab govitecan-hziy (SG), administrado en una dosis y un esquema alternativos, en personas con cáncer de mama triple negativo avanzado. El SG se administra por vena (intravenosa) y los participantes lo reciben hasta progresión de la enfermedad, muerte, toxicidad inaceptable u otro criterio de suspensión; la dosis específica y la frecuencia no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad y la tolerancia, la tasa de respuesta objetiva y la supervivencia libre de progresión (Fase 1/2).
who_for: Adults 18 or older who can give written informed consent.
Confirmed triple-negative breast cancer that is unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic.
Phase 1: refractory or relapsed after at least one prior systemic therapy; UGT1A1 wild-type during safety run-in.
Phase 2: no prior systemic therapy for advanced disease, and PD-L1 CPS below 10 (exceptions apply for CPS 10 or higher).
Measurable disease, ECOG 0 or 1, and adequate blood counts, liver and kidney function.
not_for: Prior treatment with a topoisomerase 1 inhibitor or an antibody-drug conjugate containing one.
Prior treatment with a TROP2-directed antibody-drug conjugate.
